'''DecipherCon 2002''' was held 1–3 November 2002 at the Chesapeake Conference Center. It hosted the first Players Committee [[2002 World Championship]].<ref name="dcon-fmt">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020810223927/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/worldsformats.html World Championship Event Formats & Prizes] (Wayback, 10 August 2002)</ref><ref name="tfn">[https://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/World_Championship_Results_announced_64778.asp World Championship Results announced], theforce.net (3 November 2002)</ref>

[[Angelo Consoli]] won the Star Wars CCG World Championship. [[Greg Shaw]] finished 2nd.
